bends.note: turns north-east (diagonal part carries the label AVE.)
strip running north reaches boundary lines running east at y 1945 / 2125; continuation unclear
turns east toward Vine Street (junction with Vine near 8935,6125, outside this strip's margin)

ends.note: dead end, closed by a bar north of Juergens Avenue
plate edge cuts the street lengthwise along the bottom; centre estimated from north edge + 25 ft

notes: Ringwalt is printed without suffix west of Green Hill Avenue; the diagonal continuation north-east carries 'AVE.', so taken as Ringwalt Avenue. Green Hill Avenue is only about 25 ft wide between y 5340 and 5700 (west half not opened). Greendale name is printed west of the strip (x about 5700); 'AVENUE' printed on its diagonal east part. Vine Street name printed at about 9480,5450; it carries a car track slightly east of centre; the centre is taken midway between its edges. McAlpin Avenue is cut by the plate's bottom edge, so its centre (and the Vine crossing) is less certain, about 20 px. Dell Eva Lane is a named lane (narrow in the west, widening at Green Hill Avenue). Steps printed between lots 60 and 55 north of Severn Avenue (x 6680) are not a street. OLD WATER WAY in the cemetery land (top) and a PRIVATE DRIVE near 6650,1900 are not streets. Vine x Lauk (about 8935,6125) lies beyond the 300 px margin and is not picked.
